text: I am distressed for you, my brother Jonathan; very pleasant have you been to me; your love to me was extraordinary, surpassing the love of women.
May you be blessed by the LORD, because you showed this loyalty to Saul your lord and buried him.
Do you not know that a prince and a great man has fallen this day in Israel?
It was before the LORD, who chose me above your father and above all his house, to appoint me as prince over Israel, the people of the LORD—and I will celebrate before the LORD.
And your house and your kingdom shall be made sure forever before me. Your throne shall be established forever.
What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog such as I?

The ark and Israel and Judah dwell in booths, and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are camping in the open field. Shall I then go to my house, to eat and to drink and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing.
You are the man! Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, 'I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul.'
No, my brother, do not violate me, for such a thing is not done in Israel; do not do this outrageous thing.
As the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king shall be, whether for death or for life, there also will your servant be.
Get out, get out, you man of blood, you worthless man!

You know that your father and his men are mighty men, and that they are enraged, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Besides, your father is expert in war; he will not spend the night with the people.
O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! Would I had died instead of you, O Absalom, my son, my son!

because you love those who hate you and hate those who love you. For you have made it clear today that commanders and servants are nothing to you, for today I know that if Absalom were alive and all of us were dead today, then you would be pleased.
We have no portion in David, and we have no inheritance in the son of Jesse; every man to his tents, O Israel!
This God—his way is perfect; the word of the LORD proves true; he is a shield for all those who take refuge in him.
Now these are the last words of David: The oracle of David, the son of Jesse, the oracle of the man who was raised on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
No, but I will buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to the LORD my God that cost me nothing.
